The types Task 7 builds against do not exist yet. If Task 7 runs without Task 6 being done first, every import of ContentBlock/BlockType/MessageItem will fail at compile time.
findings.fix: Task 6 must reach status=done before Task 7 executes. Validate this pre-condition at task-start (check that 'MESSAGE' appears in frontend/types/funnel.ts before proceeding).

findings.issue: Task 8 TDD Anchor instructs rewriting the existing FunnelMessagePreview.spec.ts at 'frontend/tests/components/funnels/FunnelMessagePreview.spec.ts'. The existing spec (11.7 KB) tests the OLD single-block model (SEND_MESSAGE/SEND_IMAGE/MENU, flat text/caption/parseMode request shape, single 'rendered' string response). Task 8 rewrites both the spec AND the component. The current store spec at frontend/tests/stores/funnels.spec.ts:235–262 also tests the OLD PreviewStepRequest shape ({stepType, text, parseMode}). Task 8 must also update the STORE spec to match the new blocks-based PreviewStepRequest — this is mentioned ('tests/stores/funnels.spec.ts zелена після оновлення') but not explicitly in the TDD Anchor list of tests to write. The risk is that the agent rewrites the component spec but leaves the store spec testing the old shape, causing a spec pass on mocked but fail on real types.
findings.fix: Add to Task 8 TDD Anchor: also update tests/stores/funnels.spec.ts preview test (currently line 235) to send blocks[] in PreviewStepRequest and expect renderedBlocks[] in PreviewStepResponse.

findings.issue: Task 8 instructs FunnelMessagePreview.vue to change 'isMessageStep' from the MESSAGE_TYPES array check to 'stepType === MESSAGE'. But at the same time the task tells the implementer to 'delete MESSAGE_TYPES array with old types'. This is correct behavior — however the task's Details section says 'isMessageStep → stepType === MESSAGE (видалити MESSAGE_TYPES масив зі старими типами)'. After Task 6, the only message step type will be 'MESSAGE'. The component's runPreview() currently sends {stepType, text: previewText(step), parseMode} — the new shape will be {stepType, blocks: step.blocks}. The task correctly calls this out, but does NOT mention that the current watch() at lines 108–125 watches [step.text, step.caption, step.parseMode] — these will no longer exist on FunnelStep after Task 1/6. The watch must be changed to watch step.blocks (deep). The task does mention this in the 'What to do' step 2 but omits it from the TDD Anchor test list, increasing the risk of an agent forgetting to cover reactive block changes in the spec.
findings.fix: Add a TDD anchor test: 'watch reacts to step.blocks change → schedulePreview called'. This covers the reactive wiring that is load-bearing for the debounce behavior.

findings.issue: Task 7 step 4 says 'клієнт-валідація — computed-функції, що повертають локалізований error або null'. The MENU_END_TARGET sentinel (__END__) and associated menuTargetOptions computed are reused for the button/timeout sub-editor. Task 7 instructs to reuse this pattern 1:1, but the initialButtonRows() function on line 80 seeds from 'props.initial?.stepType === MENU' — after Task 7, this must be changed to seed from 'props.initial?.stepType === MESSAGE'. The task mentions this correctly in the 'Edge cases' section (edit existing composer-крок → seed блоків із props.initial.blocks), but the implementation hint does not call out that the initialButtonRows() seed condition must change from MENU to MESSAGE. An agent following the pattern literally may seed buttons from MENU-typed initial steps only.
findings.fix: Add to implementation hints or edge-cases: 'in initialButtonRows(), change the seed guard from stepType === MENU to stepType === MESSAGE; similarly for menuTimeoutValue/Unit/Target initialization at lines 102–113'.

findings.issue: Task 7 step 2 describes the Album type-mixing predicate: 'all photo / all video / mix photo+video — OK; audio or document mixed with others — error'. However the MediaItem interface (to be defined in Task 6) does NOT have a per-item sub-type field based on what's described in the tech-spec Data Models: 'record MediaItem(String mediaUrl, String caption)'. The Edge cases section acknowledges this: 'звірити модель MediaItem/album у типах Task 6: чи несе елемент свій підтип'. If MediaItem has no sub-type, the client-side type-mixing validation is impossible to implement correctly at the album-item level. This is a potential design gap between the task spec and the data model that needs resolution in Task 6.
findings.fix: Before Task 7 implements album type-mixing validation, confirm Task 6 adds a mediaType or similar discriminator field to MediaItem, or clarify how the frontend determines per-item photo/video/audio/file classification.

findings.issue: Task 9 is a code audit task with no code written. It is sound in structure. If Tasks 1–8 haven't populated decisions.md by the time Task 9 runs, the audit step that relies on it ('дополнить тем, что зафиксировано в decisions.md') will find nothing to supplement the tech-spec file list. The depends_on: [1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8] correctly enforces ordering, but the post-completion requirement for Tasks 1–8 to write to decisions.md is a soft convention not enforced by the harness.
